page.content:
Sulaco unit sent to LV-426 in Aliens.

How Colonial Marines connects

  • Character: Dwayne Hicks — Hicks is a Colonial Marine corporal on the Sulaco.
  • Character: Bishop — Bishop is the Sulaco android attached to the Marines.
  • Item: USS Sulaco — The Marines deploy from the Sulaco.

What is Colonial Marines?

The Colonial Marines are the armed unit Hicks, Hudson, Vasquez, and the others belong to when Ripley returns to the colony and the hive.

Key threads lead to Dwayne Hicks, Bishop and USS Sulaco.
